preconditions.description: The number of notes n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 200000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each note position a_i must be between 1 and 200,000.
The length of the list of note positions must equal n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(b) else all(1 <= b_i <= 5 for b_i in b)
postconditions.description: If no convenient fingering exists, output -1; otherwise, output a valid fingering with each finger number between 1 and 5.

postconditions.expression: all(b[i] < b[i+1] if a[i] < a[i+1] else True for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: For each pair of consecutive notes, if the note position increases, the corresponding finger number must also increase.

postconditions.expression: all(b[i] > b[i+1] if a[i] > a[i+1] else True for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: For each pair of consecutive notes, if the note position decreases, the corresponding finger number must also decrease.

postconditions.expression: all(b[i] != b[i+1] if a[i] == a[i+1] else True for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: For each pair of consecutive notes, if the note position is the same, the corresponding finger numbers must be different.
